title: co2ntent — Project Context
text: R package calculating blood CO2 O2 content using canonical physiological models. Three CO2 methods: Douglas (1988), Siggaard-Andersen (1988), Loeppky (1983). One O2 method: Gregory (1974). pO2→SO2 via Kelman (1966). Two built-datasets Loeppky (1983).

title: Calculating CO2 Content of Blood
text: Several canonical methods calculating CO2 content blood described. co2ntent currently implements three methods: Douglas et al. (1988) Siggaard-Andersen et al. (1988) Loeppky et al. (1983) Using data Table 3 Douglas et al. (1988), vignette demonstrate calculation CO2 content whole blood (CtCO2Ct_{CO_2})compare method measured values CtCO2Ct_{CO_2}. Measurements wre performed using Van Slyke method determining total CO2 content (CtCO2.VSCt_{CO_2.VS}) vacuum extraction; releasing gases blood sample using acid, followed manometric measurement.
code: # Calculate CO2 content via the three canonical methods df <- co2ntent::douglas_table_3 |>    mutate(     douglas_co2_blood_ct_ml_dl = co2_content(       pco2 = pco2_torr,       ph = ph,       haemoglobin_g_dl = haemoglobin_g_dl,       so2_fraction = so2_fraction,       phase = "blood",       method = "douglas",       content_units = "ml/dL",       pressure_units = "mmHg"     ),     siggaard_co2_blood_ct_ml_dl = co2_content(       # calculate hco3       hco3_mmols_l = purrr::map2_dbl(         pco2_torr,         ph,         actual_bicarbonate_content_mmol_l,         pco2_units = "mmHg"       ),       pco2 = pco2_torr,       haemoglobin_g_dl = haemoglobin_g_dl,       so2_fraction = so2_fraction,       ph = ph,       phase = "blood",       method = "siggaard_andersen",       content_units = "ml/dL",       pressure_units = "mmHg"     ),     loeppky_co2_blood_ct_ml_dl = co2_content(       pco2 = pco2_torr,       phase = "blood",       method = "loeppky",       content_units = "ml/dL",       pressure_units = "mmHg"     )   )

title: Calculating SO2 from pO2
text: mathematical model Kelman (1966) used describe dissociation curve takes following form: SO2=100⋅a1⋅pO2+a2⋅pO22+a3⋅pO23+pO24a5⋅pO2+a6⋅pO22+a7⋅pO23+pO24 \begin{equation}   S_{O_2} = 100 \cdot \frac {a_1 \cdot p_{O_2} + a_2 \cdot p_{O_2}^2 + a_3 \cdot p_{O_2}^3 + p_{O_2}^4}{a_5 \cdot p_{O_2} + a_6 \cdot p_{O_2}^2 + a_7 \cdot p_{O_2}^3 + p_{O_2}^4} \end{equation} : a1=−8.5322289×103a2=2.1214010×103a3=−6.7073989×101a4=9.3596087×105a5=−3.1346258×104a6=2.3961674×103a7=−6.7104406×101 \begin{aligned} a_1 &=  -8.5322289 \times 10^3 \\ a_2 &=  2.1214010 \times 10^3 \\ a_3 &=  -6.7073989 \times 10^1 \\ a_4 &=  9.3596087 \times 10^5 \\ a_5 &=  -3.1346258 \times 10^4 \\ a_6 &=  2.3961674 \times 10^3 \\ a_7 &=  -6.7104406 \times 10^1 \end{aligned} account respiratory, metabolic temperature disturbances oxygen affinity haemoglobin requires transform applied pO2p_{O_2} preceding calculation can performed. Kelman (1966) defines transform pO2virtualp_{O_2}virtual : pO2virtual=pO2×10(0.024⋅(37−temp)+0.40⋅(pH−7.40)+0.06⋅(log10(40)−log10(pCO2))) \begin{equation} p_{O_2}virtual = p_{O_2} \times 10^{(0.024\cdot(37-temp) + 0.40\cdot(pH - 7.40) + 0.06\cdot(log_{10}(40) - log_{10}(p_{CO_2})))}  \end{equation}

title: Calculate Carbon Dioxide and Oxygen content of blood
text: example demonstrating con2tent can used tidyverse functions inbuilt dataset.
code: library(dplyr) library(tidyr) library(ggplot2) library(co2ntent)  # Table 3 data from Douglas et al 1988 names(co2ntent::douglas_table_3) # [1] "subject"                  "sample_type"              "ph" # [4] "haemoglobin_g_dl"         "so2_fraction"             "blood_co2_content_ml_dl" # [7] "pco2_torr"                "plasma_co2_content_ml_dl"  co2ntent::douglas_table_3 |>   mutate(     # calculate douglas blood content     douglas_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl = co2_content(       pco2 = pco2_torr,       ph = ph,       haemoglobin_g_dl = haemoglobin_g_dl,       so2_fraction = so2_fraction,       phase = "blood",       method = "douglas",       content_units = "ml/dL",       pressure_units = "mmHg"     ),     siggaard_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl = co2_content(       # calculate hco3       hco3_mmols_l = purrr::map2_dbl(         pco2_torr,         ph,         actual_bicarbonate_content_mmol_l,         pressure_units = "mmHg"       ),       pco2 = pco2_torr,       haemoglobin_g_dl = haemoglobin_g_dl,       so2_fraction = so2_fraction,       ph = ph,       phase = "blood",       method = "siggaard_andersen",       content_units = "ml/dL",       pressure_units = "mmHg"     )   ) |>   select(     blood_co2_content_ml_dl,     douglas_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl,     siggaard_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl   ) |>   pivot_longer(     c(       douglas_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl,       siggaard_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl     ),     names_to = "calculated_method",     values_to = "calculated_content"   ) |>   mutate(     calculated_method = if_else(       calculated_method == "douglas_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl",       "Douglas",       "Siggard-Andersen"     )   ) |>    ggplot(aes(     blood_co2_content_ml_dl,     calculated_content,     colour = calculated_method   )) +   geom_point() +   geom_smooth(method = 'lm') +   geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +   theme_classic() +   labs(     title = "Comparison of methods of CO2 content calculation vs Actual Content",     subtitle = "Original data from Loeppky, Luft, and Fletcher (1983)",     x = "Actual CO2 content ml/dl",     y = "Calculated CO2 content ml/dl",     colour = "Calculation Method"   ) +   theme(     legend.position = "bottom"   )

title: High-level interface for CO2 content calculations — co2_content
